Chicago ATM study

Detailed retrospective XGBoost analysis · train 2024, evaluate 2025 · primary radius 50 m

Adding environmental variables changed 2025 average precision by -0.0465; the 95% spatial-bootstrap interval is [-0.0873, -0.0035]. The interval supports worse performance in this evaluation.

Exploratory retrospective analysis. Chicago has no original report dates: the seven past-crime inputs use occurrence-year records from a later extract. No outcome-year crime, identifiers, future exposure fields or coordinates enter the models; historical reporting availability still cannot be verified. The 2025 data did not participate in tuning, exclusions, early stopping or threshold selection. Both years were already examined in earlier study decisions and are not pristine holdouts. Temporal evaluation permits recurring sites; it does not test unseen cities. OSM is incomplete and may duplicate facilities, and block geocodes limit 25–100 m precision. Correlations are pairwise associations; SHAP explains model predictions in log-odds; neither proves causation. Correlated variables can share or substitute importance. Spatial bootstrap intervals condition on the fitted model and chosen grid; adjacent blocks can remain dependent and source uncertainty is not captured. Missing is not zero. Constant and exact-duplicate candidates remain in the statistical report but are excluded using training data only.

Higher AP/AUC is better; lower Brier/log loss is better. A probability threshold of 0.5 defines the classification metrics here. Full outputs also include a training-only threshold. The interval on the difference above is paired: the models are compared on the same resampled spatial blocks.

Two different rankings

Correlation measures one parameter's association with observed crime. SHAP measures that parameter's contribution inside a model using many parameters together. Neither is causal. Strong association does not guarantee additional predictive value when other similar parameters are present.

Missing data

Missing values stay missing and XGBoost learns routing on training data. The seven unavailable original report-filtered crime variables were not filled. Separate retrospective substitutes are named explicitly. Neighborhood values come from fixed older ACS/EPA vintages. Constants and exact duplicates are identified in each training fold.

Training and exact selected settings

Four training-year spatial folds, 2 km grid groups, 1 km purge and no shared ACS/EPA areas. Objective: binary logistic. Tree method: histogram on CPU. Each family/radius chooses among the eight prespecified candidates by mean training-fold average precision. The 2025 labels were not used for this selection.

How to read parameter statistics

Statistics are separate by year. Spearman rho compares ranks, Pearson r compares numeric values (point-biserial for the binary label), and Kendall tau measures rank agreement. Crime counts and separate robbery/burglary counts are descriptive outcomes. The confidence intervals use spatial clusters. Cluster-rank p values are approximate regression tests on ranks; BH q values adjust within each year/outcome across the parameter family. IID p values ignore spatial dependence and are included only for transparency. Missingness is reported separately for crime-positive and crime-negative locations. A bootstrap rank range shows how unstable a ranking may be.

SHAP values are in log-odds. Their sum plus the base contribution reproduces the model margin. The value–SHAP correlation gives a rough direction, not a universal or causal effect. Permutation AP drop measures the loss of test performance after shuffling one variable; related variables can substitute for each other, and the shuffle can produce unrealistic combinations. Permutation ranges cover repeats, not population uncertainty.

What can be applied to other cities?

The saved 2024-trained models and feature schemas can generate predictions for NYC/LA. Matching columns, units and retrospective crime definitions are required. The transfer command exports predictions and feature-distribution drift without evaluating their labels by default. Only a separate target-city evaluation can establish transfer performance; the Chicago ranking is not automatically valid elsewhere. The regional constants excluded in Chicago cannot acquire new learned effects during transfer.

Exact commands and CPU GCP guidance are in the reproduction guide. Independent scientific review remains pending.
